reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Assumed the Parsnip gig is Voices Carry LI. A different 'Voices Carry' 80s 'Bandaoke' act exists on Facebook; not confirmed which plays Parsnip.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Two Long Island acts may share this name: (1) Voices Carry LI (this entry) - 5-piece 80s-2000s cover band, confirmed only through its YouTube channel, whose profile picture is the logo recorded here; (2) 'Voices Carry - The 80's band with You as lead singer (Bandaoke!)', Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/voicescarryband/ (seen in search results; Facebook is blocked by robots.txt for our checks, so not opened). They might be the same band, but I could not confirm, so no Facebook recorded. The Parsnip Lake House show (Oct 3, 2026) is billed just 'Voices Carry', so which act plays there is still unconfirmed. No website, Instagram or booking contact found. No photos (only YouTube video frames exist). Current description still fits the YouTube channel.
